About: Encounter Cards (NemesisMod.Cards.cs). These are the mod's own encounters - edit them, or add cards in any other .json file here.

Cards.Title: Out in the world
Cards.Notes: He and his men are found doing something (a fire, a smoke, a bottle, keeping watch, on the move). They see you, he squares up.

Cards.Title: Riders from behind
Cards.Notes: You're riding: they come up behind you on horses and run you down.

Cards.Title: Waiting on the road
Cards.Notes: You're riding: they wait ahead of you on the road and open up within 45 m.

Cards.Title: Sniper on the high ground
Cards.Notes: A murderous man takes the high ground with a rifle; only marked once he fires.

Cards.Title: Call-out in town
Cards.Notes: In town: idling somewhere until he spots you, then he walks over and squares up.

Cards.Title: Cavalry
Cards.Notes: An Army officer rides with his troopers.

Cards.Title: Army on the road
Cards.Notes: A squad waits ahead on the road.

Cards.Title: Army squad
Cards.Notes: A squad on patrol. The Army doesn't talk: once they see you, it's on.

Cards.Title: Faction skirmish
Cards.Notes: Two factions going at each other ahead of you.

Cards.Title: Patrol on the road
Cards.Notes: A patrol marches past (or raids a camp nearby).

Cards.Title: Riders on the ridge
Cards.Notes: Wapiti riders sit their horses on high ground and watch you go by, then ride off. Get close, fire near them or wait them out and they leave; shoot one and they come down at you.

Cards.Title: Wapiti patrol
Cards.Notes: Rarely, a few Wapiti riders cross their country. They leave you be unless you give them a reason - and they keep clear of gunfire.

Cards.Title: Wapiti war party
Cards.Notes: Once you've given them a reason: a war party of a named warrior and his men, found in their country.
Taunts: You were warned to leave us be.
You came back. That was a mistake.
You don't ride here any more.

Cards.Title: Wapiti riders
Cards.Notes: Once you've given them a reason: they ride you down.
Taunts: You should have stayed off our land.

Cards.Title: Warband
Cards.Notes: In a war zone: riders of one side go past you to hit the other. Follow them and the fight is there.

Cards.Title: Ambush in progress
Cards.Notes: In a war zone: one side waits by a road ahead for the other's riders. Warn them, join in or ride on.

Cards.Title: Just after
Cards.Notes: In a war zone: you come upon a fight that has just ended - the dead, and the men still standing.

Cards.Title: Bounty hunters
Cards.Notes: A rich man who won't come himself pays bounty hunters. Disable to stop it.

Cards.Title: Up the road on a wagon
Cards.Notes: He drives a wagon (a stagecoach if he's rich or an officer) up the road toward you, his men aboard. He climbs down when he sees you.
Cards.History: CAME UP THE ROAD on a wagon ({place})

Cards.Title: Back with friends
Cards.Notes: You knocked him out last time: he comes back with more men, no talking.
Taunts: You put me in the dirt, {name}. Brought some friends this time.
Cards.History: CAME BACK WITH MORE MEN after you knocked him out ({place})

Cards.Title: Back from the dead
Cards.Notes: You left him for dead: he walks up to show you the scar.
Taunts: Takes more than that to kill me.
Cards.History: CAME BACK FROM THE DEAD for you ({place})

Cards.Title: Squaring it
Cards.Notes: He surrendered / backed down last time: he comes alone, says his piece and goes - unless you start it.
Taunts: You let me walk. I came to say it - we're square. This once.
No trouble. Just wanted you to know I ain't forgot.
Cards.History: CAME TO SQUARE IT with you - no fight ({place})

Cards.Title: Tired of chasing
Cards.Notes: He got away from you twice running: he brings riders.
Taunts: You keep running, {name}. Not this time.
Cards.History: RODE YOU DOWN after you got away twice ({place})

Cards.Title: Again?
Cards.Notes: He killed you last time: he waits on the road, cocky.
Taunts: Back for more? Last time didn't take?
Cards.History: WAITED ON THE ROAD - he killed you last time ({place})
